The news organization known as the '''Senatorial News Agency''' occupied a tower located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]<ref name="SWCL" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events shown in the image in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] in which the Senatorial News Agency is mentioned to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> The agency's building was was built in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], an upscale region near the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] used by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="SWCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Senatorial News Agency was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', which was written by [[Curtis Saxton]] and [[Simon Beecroft]].<ref name="InsideAOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
